Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Cairo, Egypt.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:The visa is issued at the Embassy of the Republic of Senegal in Rome:phone: 0039 06 687 2353e-mail: ambasenequiri@tiscali.it
Regular passport YES

Citizens of the Republic of Senegal are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Cairo, Egypt.
